title: Real Numbers
preview: Terminating and repeating decimals, square and cube roots, the real number system, and estimating, comparing, and ordering irrational numbers.
description: Students connect fractions to their decimal expansions, work with square and cube roots, classify numbers within the real number system, and estimate irrationals to compare and order real numbers.

sections.label: 2-1 Terminating and Repeating Decimals
sections.description: Convert fractions to decimals and classify the decimal expansion: terminating or repeating.

sections.label: 2-2 Roots
sections.description: Square roots and cube roots: perfect vs non-perfect, and finding side lengths from area and volume.

sections.label: 2-3 Real Numbers
sections.description: Classify numbers as rational or irrational and place them within the real number system.

sections.label: 2-4 Estimate Irrational Numbers
sections.description: Locate square and cube roots between two consecutive integers using perfect-square benchmarks.

sections.label: 2-5 Compare and Order Real Numbers
sections.description: Estimate irrationals to compare and order real numbers given in mixed forms.

source.name: Plug N Play
source.attribution: Plug N Play. Module organisation aligned to Indiana grade-8 academic standards (real numbers, 8.NS.1 / 8.NS.2).
